supabaseUrl.title: Supabase URL
supabaseUrl.description: Your Supabase project URL. Falls back to SUPABASE_URL env var.

supabaseKey.title: Supabase Service Role Key
supabaseKey.description: Supabase service role key. Falls back to SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY env var.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Number of roles to upsert per Supabase batch. Default: 200.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of parallel Claude API calls per batch chunk. Default: 8.
